messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: p95 east-west latency between rack7 GPU nodes spiked >120ms during peak batch window (12:05-12:12). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/in/dash/ew-latency (alert id: EW-LAT-772)

marta: seeing it, batch ramp started ~12:03, throughput +40% on model-serving.

jon: can someone run a quick iperf/packet check inside rack7? reproduce from 7a -> 7b?

ralph: running iperf3 now between gpu-7a and gpu-7b, results look bad:
```
$ iperf3 -c gpu-7b -t 10
[ ID] Interval           Transfer     Bitrate         Retr  
[  5]   0.00-10.00  sec  1.02 GBytes   877 Mbits/sec  234             
iperf Done.
RTT samples (ping): avg 132ms, packet loss ~38%
```

kuma: checked dmesg on gpu-7b, seeing RDMA/PSM2 retries and qp flushes:
```
[  120.123456] psm2: async event: psm2_err - retry timeout
[  120.127890] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: rq error, flushing qp
```

marta: ethtool -S on eth0 of gpu-7b shows increasing rx_error and dropped counters:
```
eth0: rx_errors: 482 tx_errors: 0 rx_dropped: 51
```
/sbin/ifconfig eth0 shows RX packets with drops.

jon: any recent MTU/jumbo changes on this rack? MTU mismatch between host <-> TOR can cause fragment/rcv path issues.

deploy-bot: NOTE: network config change deployed to rack7 at 11:55 — jumbo frames enabled (MTU=9000) on hosts and pushed to TOR3 via netcfg v2.1.0.

marta: ah. MTU flip during ramp could explain fragmentation and RDMA oddness. rolling back TOR3 MTU immediately is high risk during traffic — suggestion: soft mitigate by redispatching batch traffic to spare racks and throttle batch ramp to 70% for 15m.

ralph: applied temporary route rule to redirect model-serving-batch traffic from rack7 -> rack3 spare pool (rule id: rr-7f3). Confirming policy applied.

jon: after redirect, p95 back down to ~22ms for affected flows. Good catch. Will keep redirected for 30m while we capture logs. :thumbsup:

marta: creating incident ticket INC-3801 for postmortem + rollback plan. Assigning to @kuma and @jon. Please attach pcap, iperf logs, dmesg and ethtool outputs.

kuma: capturing ibdump and tcpdump on gpu-7a/7b now, storing to /var/tmp/inc3801/. Also going to pull mlx5 and psm2 firmware versions.

infra-bot: Incident INC-3801 auto-ack by @sre-oncall. State: mitigated (traffic redispatched). Next update scheduled in 15m.

sre-oncall: acknowledging. Thanks team — will coordinate controlled MTU rollback during maintenance window tomorrow if hardware/fw checks out.

marta: quick notes for postmortem: 1) avoid MTU flips during peak batch ramps, 2) add preflight check that verifies TOR+host MTU sync and rdma health before rolling jumbo.

jon: adding runbook step to temporarily throttle batch-scheduler when netcfg changes are in progress.

ralph: logs uploaded to INC-3801, link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-3801/logs

marta: nice work. keeping this thread for followups. :white_check_mark:
